name: Parshuram Kumar
headline: Software Developer
tagline: I build backends that stay correct when things go wrong.
bio: I'm Parshuram Kumar, a software developer based in New Delhi. I work as an Associate Software Developer at VakeelSaab, a legal-tech platform, where I own call-status reliability and the search and statistics APIs across a NestJS microservices stack.

I like problems with real data behind them: telephony webhooks that arrive out of order, queries slower than they need to be, services that must agree with each other. I also build with LLMs (RAG on Postgres, Gemini transcription) and ship side projects in Next.js and Python.
I hold an MCA from BVICAM (CGPA 8.6) and a BCA from IGNOU, and keep my problem-solving sharp with 480+ LeetCode problems.
